**Checklist**

- [ ] Field names are exactly the ones in `templates/item.json` and `templates/author.json`
- [ ] `author_username` matches my file in `authors/`, and its `github` field is the account opening this PR

- [ ] `screenshot.png` is a real PNG, 800x600 px recommended
